::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 8th [1895]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/32[^1]
:::

My dear [Mrs Trebeck](people/person_1416.qmd)
Thank you for your excellent letter, I hope you are going to circulate it and that it is not to be only diocesan

What a tower of defence we have lost in [Lord Selborne](people/person_1129.qmd)[^2]

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to Mrs Trebeck/ Southwell and postmarked Winchester 8 May 1895 and Southwell 9 May 1895.
[^2]: Roundell Palmer, 1st Earl of Selborne (1812-4 May 1895).
